outcome.reason: Customer disputed a transaction of 12,000 rupees on the credit card statement.

transcript.text: Hello, this is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul. What’s this call about?
Thanks. I'm just calling about your Mumbai Bank credit card - the payment is due. By when are you planning to pay?
Wait a minute. I saw a charge of Rs 12,000 on my statement that I never made. I’m not paying anything until you investigate this.

I see, Rahul. Thanks for letting me know about the charge you’re disputing. I’m not allowed to handle disputes directly, but I’ll arrange for a human support agent to call you back about this. 

Thank you for your time. Have a good day.
